name: 2-Block Littlestone Dimension of Singletons
proof: For $n=1$, no coordinate splits the sole concept, so the value is zero. For $n\ge2$, any coordinate gives a depth-one tree, with a truncated final block allowed. Every root has a singleton positive branch, so no complete depth-two tree is shattered. The block constraint cannot create additional shattered trees; hence the value is one. This is also the singleton specialization of Proposition \ref{prop:block-littlestone-sandwich}.
